name: ui.panel
description: One square dark slate panel, perfectly frontal and axis aligned. Thin aged bronze rim with small stepped corners, flat almost-black blue slate center with extremely sparse texture. Uniform straight edge rails. Center 70 percent completely quiet and empty. Transparent outside. For nine-slice stretching.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE original dark fantasy pixel art UI asset. Thick near-black outlines, bold pixel clusters, high contrast, minimal shading, muted metal and stone. No letters, no words, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no commercial game imitation. One square dark slate panel, perfectly frontal and axis aligned. Thin aged bronze rim with small stepped corners, flat almost-black blue slate center with extremely sparse texture. Uniform straight edge rails. Center 70 percent completely quiet and empty. Transparent outside. For nine-slice stretching. Centered with 5 percent transparent outer padding. Genuine transparent background.
